title: v4 「코디세이호, 승선하라」 컷 리스트 (한 컷 = 한 사람 대사)
look: Cinematic live-action Korean TV commercial, 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, golden-hour natural light, deadpan comedic tone with a perfectly serious epic sea-adventure look, natural skin texture, 16:9, no outer space, no swords, no weapons, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

scenes.name: 출항 신호
scenes.set: on the bow of {SHIP} on a dark rough sea under gathering storm clouds, golden light breaking through
scenes.key: Medium shot of {CAPTAIN} standing at the bow facing the camera, coat and braid whipping in the wind.

cuts.shot: Slow push-in from a wide aerial view of the ship to a medium shot of {CAPTAIN} at the bow facing the camera, coat and braid whipping in the wind.
lines: in a grand, slow, solemn voice
in a sudden flat, bored, matter-of-fact voice
cuts.note: 3-4s: silence except waves, she just stares into the camera.

scenes.name: 국문과
scenes.set: at a sunny wooden pier in front of a riverside university library, with {SHIP} docked alongside the pier
scenes.key: Two-shot: {SORA} on the pier on the left looking up, {CAPTAIN} leaning over the ship's rail on the right pointing the spyglass down at her.

cuts.shot: Low-angle medium shot of {CAPTAIN} leaning over the ship's rail, dramatically pointing the brass spyglass down toward the camera.
High-angle medium close-up of {SORA} standing on the pier, looking up, blinking, pointing at herself.
Close-up of {CAPTAIN} at the rail. 0-2s: silence, only seagulls; she slowly raises one eyebrow and nothing else.

scenes.name: 빈 문틀
scenes.set: at the foot of the boarding gangway on the pier, where a freestanding empty wooden door frame with no door in it stands in front of the gangway
scenes.key: {SORA} stepping through the empty door frame holding a blank paper ticket, {CAPTAIN} at the top of the gangway with arms crossed.

cuts.shot: Medium shot: {SORA} walks through the empty door frame holding out a blank paper ticket, then stops and looks around, confused.
Medium shot of {CAPTAIN} at the top of the gangway, arms crossed.
lines: flat, as if stating the obvious

scenes.name: 빈 지갑
scenes.set: at a busy harbor pier with cranes in the background, overcast morning, {SHIP} docked alongside
scenes.key: {DOHYUN} on the pier saluting, {CAPTAIN} on the deck of the ship above him extending her spyglass toward him.

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {CAPTAIN} on the deck rail, extending the brass spyglass toward the camera with a grand gesture.
lines: in a grand, slow, mysterious voice

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {DOHYUN} on the pier: he snaps a crisp salute, then turns his empty wallet upside down and a small puff of dust falls out.
Close-up of {CAPTAIN}. 0-1s: silence; then she nods once, flatly.

scenes.name: 장학금
scenes.set: on the sunlit deck of {SHIP}, beside an open wooden chest glowing with warm golden light, its contents hidden by the glow
scenes.key: {DOHYUN} staring at the glowing open chest, {CAPTAIN} standing beside it.

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {DOHYUN} on deck staring at the glowing open chest, puzzled.
Medium close-up of {CAPTAIN} beside the glowing chest, golden light on her face.

scenes.name: 23층
scenes.set: in a dim late-night office on the 23rd floor of a city tower, fluorescent lights, while outside the window {SHIP} floats in the night sky above the clouds
scenes.key: {MINSEOK} at his desk in the dark office, and through the window the floating ship with {CAPTAIN} at its rail.

cuts.shot: Shot from inside the office toward the window: outside, {CAPTAIN} stands at the floating ship's rail and taps on the glass with her spyglass.
lines: grand and solemn, slightly muffled through the glass

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {MINSEOK} at his desk, slowly turning only his head toward the window, exhausted.

scenes.name: 혼자
scenes.set: on the deck of {SHIP} sailing on a calm blue sea in the morning
scenes.key: {MINSEOK} leaning on the rail looking down, {CAPTAIN} standing next to him.

cuts.shot: Close-up of {MINSEOK} leaning on the rail, looking down at the sea.
Medium close-up of {CAPTAIN} standing next to him, looking at the horizon.

scenes.name: 동료
scenes.set: on the deck of {SHIP} under full cream-white sails heading into the open sea, bright sun
scenes.key: {SORA}, {DOHYUN} and {MINSEOK} together on deck, {CAPTAIN} at the ship's wheel behind them.

cuts.shot: Medium shot: {DOHYUN} salutes {MINSEOK} and {SORA} eagerly.
Medium shot of {CAPTAIN} at the ship's wheel, calm.
Wide shot of {SORA}, {DOHYUN} and {MINSEOK} side by side; {SORA} raises her fist, the two men grin and nod.

scenes.name: 노크
scenes.set: on deck in front of the cabin entrance, where a freestanding empty wooden door frame with no door stands
scenes.key: {CAPTAIN} raising her fist to knock on the empty door frame, {DOHYUN} behind her.

cuts.shot: Medium shot: {CAPTAIN} in the foreground raises her fist to knock on the empty air inside the door frame and freezes; {DOHYUN} stands behind her.
Close-up of {CAPTAIN}, fist still raised; she clears her throat awkwardly.

scenes.name: 엔드카드
scenes.set: at the bow of {SHIP} sailing toward a rising sun over the sea
scenes.key: Wide shot from behind of four people at the bow facing the sunrise: {CAPTAIN}, {SORA}, {DOHYUN}, {MINSEOK}.

cuts.shot: Wide shot from behind of exactly four people at the bow facing the sunrise: {CAPTAIN}, {SORA}, {DOHYUN} and {MINSEOK}. 0-2s: silence, only waves. Then the captain alone turns her head back over her shoulder toward the camera.
